title: Add website template: .env.example for PHP project
description: Create a .env.example file for the website template documenting all required environment variable keys with placeholder values.

steps.details:
Create src/templates/website/.env.example with:
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_NAME=your_database_name
DB_USER=your_database_user
DB_PASS=your_database_password
APP_ENV=development
APP_URL=http://localhost:8080
APP_DEBUG=true

steps.description: Verify all credential fields use placeholder values
steps.details: Confirm DB_PASS, DB_USER, and DB_NAME all have descriptive placeholder text (not real values like 'password123' or 'root').

technicalNotes: PHP projects typically load .env using a library like vlucas/phpdotenv — add it to a README note about setup
